verdict.rationale: Tavily ships an official MCP server that exposes its search, extract, crawl, map, and research tools to Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, VS Code, or any MCP client. It also offers one-step agent setup and Agent Skills for coding agents, so the API plugs into agents as ready-made tools built for direct tool-call consumption. missing for 10: explicit function-calling schema definitions (no OpenAPI spec found by probe), evidence of agent-framework integrations such as LangChain or LlamaIndex, and independent hands-on corroboration of the MCP tooling.
